{"parentUuid":"6e149385-7819-47eb-92d2-4fdf07d27dd5","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"0620594e-4d98-4377-a0b2-f29d0c1d1779","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013kT95muRWyzFxpVU3HuCJ2","type":"tool_result","content":"# Kenyon Office of Institutional Research (IR) CMS\n\nA CMS for Kenyon College's Office of Institutional Research: a two-person office\n(Director + Analyst/intern staff) that publishes survey results, data briefs,\nand durable reference documents like the Factbook and Common Data Set.\n\n## Language\n\n**Director**:\nThe admin role. Modeled on the real office's Associate VP for Institutional\nResearch — the only person who can publish or edit a Report, manage user\naccounts, and deactivate access.\n_Avoid_: Admin, superuser\n\n**Analyst**:\nThe editor role. Each intern gets their own named Analyst account (see\nADR-003). Can draft and publish Data Bites directly; can draft but not\npublish or edit Reports. Any Analyst may edit any other Analyst's draft\n(shift continuity), though the original author is preserved.\n_Avoid_: Editor, intern (interns are Analysts, not a separate role), staff\n\n**Data Bite**:\nA Post: a short, dated item — a survey result, an enrollment snapshot, an\nannouncement. The frequent, low-stakes content type. Analysts can publish\nthese without Director approval.\n_Avoid_: Update, post, announcement, article\n\n**Report**:\nA Page: a durable, cite-able reference document — the Factbook, a Common Data\nSet, the Survey Coordination Policy. Appears in public navigation. Only the\nDirector can publish or edit a Report, even one an Analyst drafted.\n_Avoid_: Page, document\n\n**Draft**:\nContent (a Data Bite or Report) that has been saved but not published. Never\nappears on the public site. Used for unreleased data, e.g. enrollment numbers\nstill being verified before the official count.\n_Avoid_: Unpublished, pending\n\n**Published**:\nContent visible on the public site. The one-way gate: a Report only crosses\nit with Director action.\n_Avoid_: Live, public\n\n**Chart image**:\nAn *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,\nor Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body and\nstored there as `image:<name>`. It belongs to its item and is published with\nit (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a\nReport's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Chart**:\nA bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or\npasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data\navailable as a table (spec #14). Stored in the body as a `chart` block the\nwriter never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.\n_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization\n\n**Editor**:\nThe visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,\ntables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.\nThe body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14,\n[ADR-005](docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md)). A part of a body it\ncan't represent is a **locked block**: shown read-only, kept byte for byte.\n_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor\n\n**Site preview**:\nA Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the\nsite's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves\nnothing and publishes nothing.\n_Avoid_: live view\n\n**Confirmation**:\nThe one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,\nupload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). Fixed text only:\nnever a title, email, filename, or password. A refused action gets an error,\nnot a Confirmation.\n_Avoid_: flash, toast, notification, success message\n\n**Factbook**:\nA specific Report: the office's running reference document of admissions,\nenrollment, diversity, and academic program statistics.\n\n**Common Data Set (CDS)**:\nA specific Report: a standardized annual institutional data submission,\npublished publicly.\n\n**Survey Calendar**:\nA specific Report: the schedule of past, current, and upcoming surveys the\noffice runs (e.g. faculty/staff surveys, external review surveys).\ntemplates/base.html\ntemplates/login.html\n\napp:\n__init__.py\n__pycache__\nauth.py\nchart_images.py\ncli.py\ncontent.py\ndata_bites.py\ndb.py\neditor.py\nflash.py\nmain.py\nmarkdown_form.py\npublic_site.py\npublish.py\nrendering.py\nreports.py\nroutes\nsettings.py\ntemplating.py\nuploads.py\nusers.py\n\ndocs:\nadr\nagents\nhandoff\nmanual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md\nmp2-grading-rubric_20260922.md\nmp2-setup_context-threshold-hook_20260922.md\nprocess\nscreenshots\ntranscripts\n\ndocs/adr:\nADR-001-local-admin-static-public.md\nADR-002-stack.md\nADR-003-split-publish-rights.md\nADR-004-chart-images.md\nADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md\n\nscripts:\n__pycache__\ncheck_submission.py\nseed_demo.py\nusage_report.py\n\nstatic:\neditor.js\n\ntemplates:\nadmin\nbase.html\nlogin.html\npublic\n\ntemplates/admin:\n_chart_images.html\n_content_fields.html\n_site_preview.html\n_undescribed_images.html\ncontent.html\ndata_bite_edit.html\ndata_bites.html\nforbidden.html\nhome.html\nreport_edit.html\nreports.html\nusers.html\n\ntemplates/public:\n_lists.html\ndata_bite.html\ndata_bites.html\nhome.html\nlayout.html\nreport.html\nreports.html\n\ntests:\n__pycache__\nconftest.py\ntest_admin_links.py\ntest_admin_pages.py\ntest_ctx_guard.py\ntest_seed_demo.py\ntest_success_messages.py\ntest_t00.py\ntest_t01_auth.py\ntest_t02_users.py\ntest_t03_data_bites.py\ntest_t04_reports.py\ntest_t05_report_files.py\ntest_t06_admin_console.py\ntest_t07_public_site.py\ntest_t08_publish.py\ntest_t09_tables.py\ntest_t10_chart_images.py\ntest_t11_report_chart_images.py\ntest_t12_site_preview.py\ntest_t13_editor_routes.py\ntest_t13_editor.py\ntest_t13_markdown_form.py\ntest_usage_report.py\n Every table's schema lives here, so init_db() builds them all.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    name          TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    is_active     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_bites (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reports (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- unique among Reports only; a Data Bite may share it\n    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    file_name  TEXT    -- the attached PDF's sanitized name for display; NULL if none\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added after a table was first created: (table, column, definition).\n# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an existing table alone, so init_db adds\n# any of these an older database is missing.\nADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    (\"reports\", \"file_name\", \"TEXT\"),\n]\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database named by settings (read at call time, so tests can swap\n    it). Commits on success, rolls back on error, always closes.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        with conn:\n            yield conn\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef init_db() -> None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        for table, column, definition in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n            existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n            if column not in existing:\n                conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}\")\n\"\"\"Markdown to safe HTML: the one pipeline every rendering of user-written\nMarkdown goes through: the public site, its export, and the Site preview.\n\nmarkdown-it-py renders (raw HTML in the Markdown is let through to it), then\nnh3 sanitizes, dropping <script>, event-handler attributes, javascript: URLs,\nand anything else not on its allowlist. The stored body stays raw; only this\nfunction's output is ever marked safe.\n\nTwo additions to nh3's allowlist, both for Markdown tables:\n  - `style` on a table cell, but only as exactly `text-align:left|right|center`,\n    so a column's alignment (`|---:|`) survives and nothing else does.\n  - the class TABLE_SCROLL on a <div>: each Markdown table is wrapped in one, so\n    a wide table can scroll sideways without restyling the <table> itself.\n\nAnd one addition to Markdown, for chart images (ADR-004): an image whose URL\nis `image:<name>` gets its URL from the `image_src` the caller passes, which\nknows the item's images and where the page being rendered finds them. A name\nit doesn't know, or no `image_src`, renders nothing. Any other image URL is\nleft to the sanitizer.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markupsafe import Markup\n\nTABLE_SCROLL = \"content-table-scroll\"\nIMAGE_REFERENCE = \"image:\"\n# A chart image's name -> its URL from the page being rendered; None if the\n# item has no image of that name.\nImageSrc = Callable[[str], \"str | None\"]\n\n_MARKDOWN = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\").enable(\"table\")\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"table_open\", lambda self, tokens, idx, options, env: (\n    f'<div class=\"{TABLE_SCROLL}\">\\n' + self.renderToken(tokens, idx, options, env)))\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"table_close\", lambda self, tokens, idx, options, env: (\n    self.renderToken(tokens, idx, options, env) + \"</div>\\n\"))\n\n\ndef _chart_image_name(token) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The name in an `image:<name>` image token; WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n        write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n\n    return attach\n\n\ndef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n    if get(report_id) is None:\n        return False\n    raise ReportLocked(LOCKED)\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given. It starts with no\n    images, even if a deleted Report that had its id left some behind (SQLite\n    may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    attach = _attaching(pdf)\n\n    def clear_images_then_attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n        if attach:\n            attach(conn, report_id)\n\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=clear_images_then_attach)\n\n\ndef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None, base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n    it is published and `user` is not a Director; StaleItem if it has changed\n    since `base` (ContentTable.update).\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                     also=_attaching(pdf), base=base):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        removed = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n        ).rowcount == 1\n    if not removed:\n        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(report_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Report's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, report_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(report_id: int, image: chart_images.Image, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image on behalf of `user`, or replace the one of the same\n    name. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked as `update`;\n    ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(_IMAGES, item_id, image)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_image(report_id: int, name: str, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove a chart image on behalf of `user`. False if there is no such\n    Report or it has no image of that name; ReportLocked as `update`.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(report_id):\n        return False\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, item_id, name)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Report, its file, and its images. False if there is no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n        return False\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"3a8506ea-6920-432a-be1c-e3c1b1e2cad1","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":4},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f69edd36-b9a6-4e52-b2c4-e26b8074dfd9","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"5f1453e3-22ca-48ab-bcdf-08e3c322f1be","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"e41fef63-c3c6-46bc-9ab7-e5b5509fec04","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"0620594e-4d98-4377-a0b2-f29d0c1d1779","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01FJfqPDYvHsLz3yMx6px4WH","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\nvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\nSTALE = \"This item changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.\"\n\n\nclass StaleItem(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"Saved from an edit form opened on an older version of the item.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef item_base(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The version of an item an edit form was opened on: a hash of its\n    stored title, slug, and body, all three of which the form saves. A hash\n    of the body alone would let a stale form overwrite a newer title or slug.\"\"\"\n    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([title, slug, body]).encode()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n                           \"choose another.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None,\n               base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. With `base`,\n        the item_base the edit form was opened on, StaleItem if the item has\n        changed since, and nothing is written. False if nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                if base is not None:\n                    # Held from the check to the write, so no other save\n                    # lands between them.\n                    conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n                    row = conn.execute(f\"SELECT title, slug, body FROM {self.table}\"\n                                       \" WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).fetchone()\n                    if row is not None and item_base(*row) != base:\n                        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def touch(self, item_id: int, *, drafts_only: bool = False,\n              also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark the item as changed now, for a change outside its row (e.g.\n        its images), made by `also` in the same transaction. With drafts_only,\n        a published item is left alone, as `update`. False if nothing was\n        changed.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            changed = conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                (item_id, drafts_only),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n            if changed and also:\n                also(conn, item_id)\n            return changed\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n\n    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n                (status, item_id),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\"\"\"The public site: every page a visitor can see, each described by the path\nit has in the exported site (e.g. \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").\n\nThe app serves these pages at those same paths (app.routes.public), and\n`cms publish` writes them there (app.publish), so the two render one set of pages\nrather than two. Pages link to each other relatively, through `root` (\"\" at\nthe top of the site, \"../\" one folder down), so the same HTML works served\nfrom / and exported to a GitHub Pages subfolder. Where each kind of page or\nfile sits is decided here, by the *_path functions, and nowhere else.\n\nContent is read only through the published-only queries (`list_published`,\n`get_published`), so a draft cannot reach a page, a link, or the navigation.\nThe one exception is a Site preview (`data_bite_preview`, `report_preview`),\nwhich the admin console renders for one item, as if it were published, and\nwhich is never written to the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom types import ModuleType\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* The public site's one stylesheet, at style.css in the site's root. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n.header-home { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n.nav-site ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; list-style: none; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n/* Admin only: the message after a successful save (app.flash). */\n.admin-confirmation { background: color-mix(in srgb, #2e7d32 12%, transparent); border-left: 4px solid #2e7d32; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; }\n/* Markdown tables, in a Data Bite's or Report's body. A wide one scrolls\n   sideways in its wrapper (app.rendering.TABLE_SCROLL) rather than widening\n   the page; on a phone, rather than squeezing its text to a word a line. */\n.content-body .content-table-scroll { margin-block: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; }\n/* Chart images (app.chart_images) shrink to the column, keeping their shape. */\n.content-body img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }\n.content-body table { border-collapse: collapse; }\n.content-body th, .content-body td { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; }\n.content-body th { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .content-body th, .content-body td { min-width: 10ch; } }\n/* A Site preview's banner (Page.render_preview); never on a published page. */\n.site-preview-banner { background: #fff4ce; border-left: 4px solid #9a6700; color: #4d3800; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; }\n/* Admin only: an edit form's fields beside its Site preview, stacked below\n   them on a narrow screen. */\nbody:has(.admin-site-preview) { max-width: 90rem; }\n.admin-content-fields textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; }\n.admin-site-preview-frame { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); box-sizing: border-box; display: block; height: 75vh; min-height: 24rem; width: 100%; }\n.admin-site-preview-frame[data-width=\"phone\"] { max-width: 100%; width: 390px; }\n/* Admin only: the Editor (static/editor.js), its toolbar, and the parts of a\n   body it can't edit, shown read-only. */\n.admin-editor-label { font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-toolbar [aria-pressed=\"true\"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent); }\n.admin-editor-link { align-items: center; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 0.5rem; margin-block: 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-link[hidden] { display: none; }\n.admin-editor-message { background: color-mix(in srgb, #b3261e 12%, transparent); border-left: 4px solid #b3261e; margin: 0.25rem 0; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; }\n.admin-editor-message:empty { display: none; }\n.admin-editor-area { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); min-height: 16rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; }\n.admin-editor-locked { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 40%, transparent); margin-block: 0.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; }\n.admin-editor-locked-note { font-size: 0.875rem; font-style: italic; margin: 0.4rem 0; }\n.admin-editor-locked pre { overflow-x: auto; }\n@media (min-width: 64rem) {\n  .admin-content-editing { align-items: start; display: grid; gap: 0 2rem; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .admin-content-editing .admin-site-preview { position: sticky; top: 1rem; }\n}\n\"\"\"\nRECENT_DATA_BITES = 5  # on the home page; the rest are on the Data Bites list\n# A new item's slug in its Site preview, which only its paths use.\n_UNSAVED_SLUG = \"untitled\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"data-bites/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\ndef report_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"reports/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef report_file_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    # .pdf, not the upload's own extension: a Report's file is always a PDF (T05).\n    return f\"reports/files/{slug}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef report_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/reports/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    path: str      # where the page sits in the site, relative to its root\n    template: str\n    context: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The chart images its body may show, {name: path in the site}.\n    images: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The Reports in its navigation; None for the published ones.\n    nav_reports: list[Mapping] | None = None\n\n    def render(self) -> str:\n        return self._render(preview_base=None)\n\n    def render_preview(self, at: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The page as a Site preview, served from `at`: the root of the\n        preview's own copy of the site, an admin path ending in \"/\". Its links\n        stay relative, as in the export, and a <base> puts the page at its\n        path under `at`, where they reach the preview's stylesheet and files.\n        It shows the \"Draft preview, not published\" banner.\"\"\"\n        return self._render(preview_base=f\"{at}{self.path}\")\n\n    def _render(self, *, preview_base: str | None) -> str:\n        root = \"../\" * self.path.count(\"/\")\n\n        def image_src(name: str) -> str | None:\n            path = self.images.get(name)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        nav_reports = reports.list_published() if self.nav_reports is None else self.nav_reports\n        return templates.env.get_template(self.template).render(\n            image_src=image_src,\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=root, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n            home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", nav_reports=nav_reports,\n            data_bite_path=data_bite_path, report_path=report_path,\n            report_file_path=report_file_path, preview_base=preview_base, **self.context)\n\n\ndef home() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\",\n                {\"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()[:RECENT_DATA_BITES]})\n\n\ndef data_bite_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"data-bites/index.html\", \"public/data_bites.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Data Bites\", \"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()})\n\n\ndef data_bite(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Data Bite's page; None for a draft or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else _data_bite_page(bite)\n\n\ndef _data_bite_page(bite: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"]), \"public/data_bite.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": bite[\"title\"], \"bite\": bite},\n                images={name: data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(data_bites, bite)})\n\n\ndef _stored_images(module: ModuleType, item: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Data Bite's or Report's chart images (`module` is its type's),\n    {name: where it is stored}; none for one not yet saved.\"\"\"\n    return {} if item[\"id\"] is None else module.images(item[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef data_bite_files(bite: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The files a Data Bite's page links to, its chart images, as {path in\n    the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(data_bites, bite).items()}\n\n\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Data Bite's chart image, at\n    data_bite_image_path(slug, name) in the site, is stored. None for a\n    draft, no such image, or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef report_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"reports/index.html\", \"public/reports.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Reports\", \"reports\": reports.list_published()})\n\n\ndef _stored_file(report: Mapping) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where the Report's file is stored, if it has one and it is there.\"\"\"\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None:\n        return None\n    stored = reports.file_path(report[\"id\"])\n    return stored if stored.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef report(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's page, linking its file only if that can be\n    downloaded; None for a draft or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else _report_page(found)\n\n\ndef _report_page(found: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(report_path(found[\"slug\"]), \"public/report.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": found[\"title\"], \"report\": found,\n                 \"has_file\": _stored_file(found) is not None},\n                images={name: report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(reports, found)})\n\n\ndef report_image_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's chart images, as {path in the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(reports, found).items()}\n\n\ndef report_pdf_file(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's file, if its page links to it (it can be downloaded), as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}; empty if not.\"\"\"\n    stored = _stored_file(found)\n    return {report_file_path(found[\"slug\"]): stored} if stored else {}\n\n\ndef report_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file a Report's page links to, as {path in the site: where it is\n    stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {**report_image_files(found), **report_pdf_file(found)}\n\n\ndef report_file(slug: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's attached file, at report_file_path(slug) in the\n    site, as (where it is stored, its display name). None for a draft, a\n    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n\n\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Report's chart image, at report_image_path(slug,\n    name) in the site, is stored. None for a draft, no such image, or no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else reports.images(found[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef pages() -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(),\n            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n\n\ndef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides the stylesheet, as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}: the published Data Bites' and\n    Reports' chart images, and the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n    found: dict[str, Path] = {}\n    for bite in data_bites.list_published():\n        found.update(data_bite_files(bite))\n    for report in reports.list_published():\n        found.update(report_files(report))\n    return found\n\n\n# Site previews: one item's page, as if it were published, with unsaved edits.\n\ndef _as_if_published(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The item a Site preview shows: `saved` (None for a new item, dated now)\n    with `form`'s unsaved title and body, published. It keeps the saved slug:\n    an unsaved slug would change only paths, which no reader sees, and with\n    the saved one the preview finds the item's files where it puts them.\"\"\"\n    item = dict(saved) if saved is not None else {\n        \"id\": None, \"slug\": _UNSAVED_SLUG, \"file_name\": None,\n        \"created_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")}\n    return {**item, \"title\": form[\"title\"].strip(), \"body\": form[\"body\"],\n            \"status\": \"published\"}\n\n\ndef data_bite_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to the Data Bite `saved` (None on\n    the create page). Render it with Page.render_preview.\"\"\"\n    return _data_bite_page(_as_if_published(form, saved))\n\n\ndef report_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"As data_bite_preview, for a Report. The Report is in the navigation,\n    in title order, as if published; every other draft is not.\"\"\"\n    report = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    others = [found for found in reports.list_published() if found[\"id\"] != report[\"id\"]]\n    # The order reports.list_published gives (title, then id), the new one last.\n    nav = sorted([*others, report],\n                 key=lambda found: (found[\"title\"], found[\"id\"] is None, found[\"id\"] or 0))\n    return replace(_report_page(report), nav_reports=nav)\n\"\"\"`cms publish`: write the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe pages and files come from app.public_site, the same ones the app serves,\nat the same paths, so the export is the live public site rather than a second\nrendering of it. That module reads only published content and links only\nrelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(public_site.CSS, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for page in public_site.pages():\n        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path, stored in public_site.files().items():\n        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    target = out / path\n    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return target","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"01680d1c-4b82-4bb3-b232-cda34bbdc078","timestamp":"2026-09-30T21:23:05.271Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\nvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\nSTALE = \"This item changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.\"\n\n\nclass StaleItem(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"Saved from an edit form opened on an older version of the item.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef item_base(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The version of an item an edit form was opened on: a hash of its\n    stored title, slug, and body, all three of which the form saves. A hash\n    of the body alone would let a stale form overwrite a newer title or slug.\"\"\"\n    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([title, slug, body]).encode()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n                           \"choose another.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None,\n               base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. With `base`,\n        the item_base the edit form was opened on, StaleItem if the item has\n        changed since, and nothing is written. False if nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                if base is not None:\n                    # Held from the check to the write, so no other save\n                    # lands between them.\n                    conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n                    row = conn.execute(f\"SELECT title, slug, body FROM {self.table}\"\n                                       \" WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).fetchone()\n                    if row is not None and item_base(*row) != base:\n                        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def touch(self, item_id: int, *, drafts_only: bool = False,\n              also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark the item as changed now, for a change outside its row (e.g.\n        its images), made by `also` in the same transaction. With drafts_only,\n        a published item is left alone, as `update`. False if nothing was\n        changed.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            changed = conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                (item_id, drafts_only),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n            if changed and also:\n                also(conn, item_id)\n            return changed\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n\n    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n                (status, item_id),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\"\"\"The public site: every page a visitor can see, each described by the path\nit has in the exported site (e.g. \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").\n\nThe app serves these pages at those same paths (app.routes.public), and\n`cms publish` writes them there (app.publish), so the two render one set of pages\nrather than two. Pages link to each other relatively, through `root` (\"\" at\nthe top of the site, \"../\" one folder down), so the same HTML works served\nfrom / and exported to a GitHub Pages subfolder. Where each kind of page or\nfile sits is decided here, by the *_path functions, and nowhere else.\n\nContent is read only through the published-only queries (`list_published`,\n`get_published`), so a draft cannot reach a page, a link, or the navigation.\nThe one exception is a Site preview (`data_bite_preview`, `report_preview`),\nwhich the admin console renders for one item, as if it were published, and\nwhich is never written to the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom types import ModuleType\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* The public site's one stylesheet, at style.css in the site's root. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n.header-home { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n.nav-site ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; list-style: none; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n/* Admin only: the message after a successful save (app.flash). */\n.admin-confirmation { background: color-mix(in srgb, #2e7d32 12%, transparent); border-left: 4px solid #2e7d32; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; }\n/* Markdown tables, in a Data Bite's or Report's body. A wide one scrolls\n   sideways in its wrapper (app.rendering.TABLE_SCROLL) rather than widening\n   the page; on a phone, rather than squeezing its text to a word a line. */\n.content-body .content-table-scroll { margin-block: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; }\n/* Chart images (app.chart_images) shrink to the column, keeping their shape. */\n.content-body img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }\n.content-body table { border-collapse: collapse; }\n.content-body th, .content-body td { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; }\n.content-body th { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .content-body th, .content-body td { min-width: 10ch; } }\n/* A Site preview's banner (Page.render_preview); never on a published page. */\n.site-preview-banner { background: #fff4ce; border-left: 4px solid #9a6700; color: #4d3800; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; }\n/* Admin only: an edit form's fields beside its Site preview, stacked below\n   them on a narrow screen. */\nbody:has(.admin-site-preview) { max-width: 90rem; }\n.admin-content-fields textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; }\n.admin-site-preview-frame { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); box-sizing: border-box; display: block; height: 75vh; min-height: 24rem; width: 100%; }\n.admin-site-preview-frame[data-width=\"phone\"] { max-width: 100%; width: 390px; }\n/* Admin only: the Editor (static/editor.js), its toolbar, and the parts of a\n   body it can't edit, shown read-only. */\n.admin-editor-label { font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-toolbar [aria-pressed=\"true\"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent); }\n.admin-editor-link { align-items: center; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 0.5rem; margin-block: 0.25rem; }\n.admin-editor-link[hidden] { display: none; }\n.admin-editor-message { background: color-mix(in srgb, #b3261e 12%, transparent); border-left: 4px solid #b3261e; margin: 0.25rem 0; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; }\n.admin-editor-message:empty { display: none; }\n.admin-editor-area { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); min-height: 16rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; }\n.admin-editor-locked { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 40%, transparent); margin-block: 0.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; }\n.admin-editor-locked-note { font-size: 0.875rem; font-style: italic; margin: 0.4rem 0; }\n.admin-editor-locked pre { overflow-x: auto; }\n@media (min-width: 64rem) {\n  .admin-content-editing { align-items: start; display: grid; gap: 0 2rem; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .admin-content-editing .admin-site-preview { position: sticky; top: 1rem; }\n}\n\"\"\"\nRECENT_DATA_BITES = 5  # on the home page; the rest are on the Data Bites list\n# A new item's slug in its Site preview, which only its paths use.\n_UNSAVED_SLUG = \"untitled\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"data-bites/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\ndef report_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"reports/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef report_file_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    # .pdf, not the upload's own extension: a Report's file is always a PDF (T05).\n    return f\"reports/files/{slug}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef report_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/reports/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    path: str      # where the page sits in the site, relative to its root\n    template: str\n    context: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The chart images its body may show, {name: path in the site}.\n    images: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The Reports in its navigation; None for the published ones.\n    nav_reports: list[Mapping] | None = None\n\n    def render(self) -> str:\n        return self._render(preview_base=None)\n\n    def render_preview(self, at: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The page as a Site preview, served from `at`: the root of the\n        preview's own copy of the site, an admin path ending in \"/\". Its links\n        stay relative, as in the export, and a <base> puts the page at its\n        path under `at`, where they reach the preview's stylesheet and files.\n        It shows the \"Draft preview, not published\" banner.\"\"\"\n        return self._render(preview_base=f\"{at}{self.path}\")\n\n    def _render(self, *, preview_base: str | None) -> str:\n        root = \"../\" * self.path.count(\"/\")\n\n        def image_src(name: str) -> str | None:\n            path = self.images.get(name)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        nav_reports = reports.list_published() if self.nav_reports is None else self.nav_reports\n        return templates.env.get_template(self.template).render(\n            image_src=image_src,\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=root, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n            home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", nav_reports=nav_reports,\n            data_bite_path=data_bite_path, report_path=report_path,\n            report_file_path=report_file_path, preview_base=preview_base, **self.context)\n\n\ndef home() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\",\n                {\"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()[:RECENT_DATA_BITES]})\n\n\ndef data_bite_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"data-bites/index.html\", \"public/data_bites.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Data Bites\", \"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()})\n\n\ndef data_bite(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Data Bite's page; None for a draft or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else _data_bite_page(bite)\n\n\ndef _data_bite_page(bite: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"]), \"public/data_bite.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": bite[\"title\"], \"bite\": bite},\n                images={name: data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(data_bites, bite)})\n\n\ndef _stored_images(module: ModuleType, item: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Data Bite's or Report's chart images (`module` is its type's),\n    {name: where it is stored}; none for one not yet saved.\"\"\"\n    return {} if item[\"id\"] is None else module.images(item[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef data_bite_files(bite: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The files a Data Bite's page links to, its chart images, as {path in\n    the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(data_bites, bite).items()}\n\n\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Data Bite's chart image, at\n    data_bite_image_path(slug, name) in the site, is stored. None for a\n    draft, no such image, or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef report_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"reports/index.html\", \"public/reports.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Reports\", \"reports\": reports.list_published()})\n\n\ndef _stored_file(report: Mapping) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where the Report's file is stored, if it has one and it is there.\"\"\"\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None:\n        return None\n    stored = reports.file_path(report[\"id\"])\n    return stored if stored.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef report(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's page, linking its file only if that can be\n    downloaded; None for a draft or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else _report_page(found)\n\n\ndef _report_page(found: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(report_path(found[\"slug\"]), \"public/report.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": found[\"title\"], \"report\": found,\n                 \"has_file\": _stored_file(found) is not None},\n                images={name: report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(reports, found)})\n\n\ndef report_image_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's chart images, as {path in the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(reports, found).items()}\n\n\ndef report_pdf_file(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's file, if its page links to it (it can be downloaded), as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}; empty if not.\"\"\"\n    stored = _stored_file(found)\n    return {report_file_path(found[\"slug\"]): stored} if stored else {}\n\n\ndef report_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file a Report's page links to, as {path in the site: where it is\n    stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {**report_image_files(found), **report_pdf_file(found)}\n\n\ndef report_file(slug: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's attached file, at report_file_path(slug) in the\n    site, as (where it is stored, its display name). None for a draft, a\n    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n\n\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Report's chart image, at report_image_path(slug,\n    name) in the site, is stored. None for a draft, no such image, or no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else reports.images(found[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef pages() -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(),\n            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n\n\ndef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides the stylesheet, as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}: the published Data Bites' and\n    Reports' chart images, and the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n    found: dict[str, Path] = {}\n    for bite in data_bites.list_published():\n        found.update(data_bite_files(bite))\n    for report in reports.list_published():\n        found.update(report_files(report))\n    return found\n\n\n# Site previews: one item's page, as if it were published, with unsaved edits.\n\ndef _as_if_published(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The item a Site preview shows: `saved` (None for a new item, dated now)\n    with `form`'s unsaved title and body, published. It keeps the saved slug:\n    an unsaved slug would change only paths, which no reader sees, and with\n    the saved one the preview finds the item's files where it puts them.\"\"\"\n    item = dict(saved) if saved is not None else {\n        \"id\": None, \"slug\": _UNSAVED_SLUG, \"file_name\": None,\n        \"created_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")}\n    return {**item, \"title\": form[\"title\"].strip(), \"body\": form[\"body\"],\n            \"status\": \"published\"}\n\n\ndef data_bite_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to the Data Bite `saved` (None on\n    the create page). Render it with Page.render_preview.\"\"\"\n    return _data_bite_page(_as_if_published(form, saved))\n\n\ndef report_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"As data_bite_preview, for a Report. The Report is in the navigation,\n    in title order, as if published; every other draft is not.\"\"\"\n    report = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    others = [found for found in reports.list_published() if found[\"id\"] != report[\"id\"]]\n    # The order reports.list_published gives (title, then id), the new one last.\n    nav = sorted([*others, report],\n                 key=lambda found: (found[\"title\"], found[\"id\"] is None, found[\"id\"] or 0))\n    return replace(_report_page(report), nav_reports=nav)\n\"\"\"`cms publish`: write the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe pages and files come from app.public_site, the same ones the app serves,\nat the same paths, so the export is the live public site rather than a second\nrendering of it. That module reads only published content and links only\nrelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(public_site.CSS, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for page in public_site.pages():\n        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path, stored in public_site.files().items():\n        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    target = out / path\n    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return target","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"bbdbcd6b-bcde-41b9-82a2-24655ccc2b26","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":4},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e41fef63-c3c6-46bc-9ab7-e5b5509fec04","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"5f1453e3-22ca-48ab-bcdf-08e3c322f1be","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}
