The Editor shows it as HTML and posts HTML\nback, which app.markdown_form turns into Markdown again. This module decides\nwhat the Editor is shown, and what a posted body saves.\n\n**Locked blocks.** A top-level block of the stored body that the Editor can't\nrepresent (a code block, raw HTML, an inline code span, ...) is *locked*: it\nis cut out and replaced by the token `locked-<n>` (n: its place among the\nbody's locked blocks), and the Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML,\nread-only. Its Markdown source never reaches the browser. On save, each token\nis replaced by that block's source from the *stored* body, never from\nanything posted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markupsafe import Markup, escape\n\nfrom app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\nfrom app.markdown_form import LINK_SCHEMES, LOCKED_TOKEN, ImageName, to_markdown\nfrom app.rendering import (IMAGE_REFERENCE, ImageSrc, parse, render_markdown,\n                           table_cell_alignment)\n\n# Block tokens the Editor can represent, and the headings among them.\n_SUPPORTED_BLOCKS = {\n    \"paragraph_open\", \"paragraph_close\", \"heading_open\", \"heading_close\", \"inline\",\n    \"bullet_list_open\", \"bullet_list_close\", \"ordered_list_open\", \"ordered_list_close\",\n    \"list_item_open\", \"list_item_close\", \"blockquote_open\", \"blockquote_close\",\n    \"table_open\", \"table_close\", \"thead_open\", \"thead_close\", \"tbody_open\", \"tbody_close\",\n    \"tr_open\", \"tr_close\", \"th_open\", \"th_close\", \"td_open\", \"td_close\",\n}\n_SUPPORTED_HEADINGS = {\"h2\", \"h3\"}\n_SUPPORTED_INLINE = {\"text\", \"softbreak\", \"hardbreak\", \"strong_open\", \"strong_close\",\n                     \"em_open\", \"em_close\", \"link_open\", \"link_close\", \"image\"}\n...\n</persisted-output>","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"e8664b4b-4964-4a78-a4d5-f9753cc36ba3","timestamp":"2026-09-30T21:23:08.565Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"The Editor's server side (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe body is stored as Markdown. The Editor shows it as HTML and posts HTML\nback, which app.markdown_form turns into Markdown again. This module decides\nwhat the Editor is shown, and what a posted body saves.\n\n**Locked blocks.** A top-level block of the stored body that the Editor can't\nrepresent (a code block, raw HTML, an inline code span, ...) is *locked*: it\nis cut out and replaced by the token `locked-<n>` (n: its place among the\nbody's locked blocks), and the Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML,\nread-only. Its Markdown source never reaches the browser. On save, each token\nis replaced by that block's source from the *stored* body, never from\nanything posted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markupsafe import Markup, escape\n\nfrom app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\nfrom app.markdown_form import LINK_SCHEMES, LOCKED_TOKEN, ImageName, to_markdown\nfrom app.rendering import (IMAGE_REFERENCE, ImageSrc, parse, render_markdown,\n                           table_cell_alignment)\n\n# Block tokens the Editor can represent, and the headings among them.\n_SUPPORTED_BLOCKS = {\n    \"paragraph_open\", \"paragraph_close\", \"heading_open\", \"heading_close\", \"inline\",\n    \"bullet_list_open\", \"bullet_list_close\", \"ordered_list_open\", \"ordered_list_close\",\n    \"list_item_open\", \"list_item_close\", \"blockquote_open\", \"blockquote_close\",\n    \"table_open\", \"table_close\", \"thead_open\", \"thead_close\", \"tbody_open\", \"tbody_close\",\n    \"tr_open\", \"tr_close\", \"th_open\", \"th_close\", \"td_open\", \"td_close\",\n}\n_SUPPORTED_HEADINGS = {\"h2\", \"h3\"}\n_SUPPORTED_INLINE = {\"text\", \"softbreak\", \"hardbreak\", \"strong_open\", \"strong_close\",\n                     \"em_open\", \"em_close\", \"link_open\", \"link_close\", \"image\"}\n_NEWLINE = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n?|\\n\")\n_LAST_ENDING = re.compile(r\"(?:\\r\\n?|\\n)\\Z\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"A body with each locked block replaced by its token.\"\"\"\n    markdown: str\n    # The locked blocks' Markdown source, by token number.\n    locked: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\ndef _supported_inline(token: Token) -> bool:\n    if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_INLINE:\n        return False\n    if token.type == \"link_open\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"href\")).lower().startswith(LINK_SCHEMES)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None)\n    if token.type == \"image\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"src\")).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n                and all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])))\n    return True\n\n\ndef _token_number(block: list[Token]) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"The number of the token a top-level block is, if it is a paragraph\n    holding nothing but one.\"\"\"\n    if [token.type for token in block] != [\"paragraph_open\", \"inline\", \"paragraph_close\"]:\n        return None\n    match = LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(block[1].content)\n    return int(match[1]) if match else None\n\n\ndef _supported(block: list[Token]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether the Editor can represent a top-level block, given as its\n    tokens: it and everything in it.\"\"\"\n    if _token_number(block) is not None:\n        # Text that reads as a token; locked, so it is never taken for one.\n        return False\n    for token in block:\n        if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_BLOCKS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"heading_open\" and token.tag not in _SUPPORTED_HEADINGS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"inline\" and not all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])):\n            return False\n    return True\n\n\ndef _top_level_blocks(tokens: list[Token]) -> list[list[Token]]:\n    \"\"\"The tokens of each top-level block, in order.\"\"\"\n    blocks: list[list[Token]] = []\n    depth = 0\n    for token in tokens:\n        if depth == 0:\n            blocks.append([])\n        blocks[-1].append(token)\n        depth += token.nesting\n    return blocks\n\n\ndef _lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"`text`'s lines, each with its line ending, numbered as markdown-it\n    numbers them (it reads \\\\r\\\\n and \\\\r as \\\\n).\"\"\"\n    parts = _NEWLINE.split(text)\n    endings = _NEWLINE.findall(text)\n    lines = [part + ending for part, ending in zip(parts, endings)]\n    return lines + [parts[-1]] if parts[-1] else lines\n\n\ndef _ending(line: str) -> str:\n    return line[len(line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")):] or \"\\n\"\n\n\ndef _is_blank(line: str) -> bool:\n    return not line.strip()\n\n\ndef tokenize(body: str) -> Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"`body` with each locked block replaced by its token, on a line of its\n    own with a blank line either side.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(body)\n    locked: list[str] = []\n    # (first line, line after the last) of each locked block.\n    spans = []\n    for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(body)):\n        if block[0].map and not _supported(block):\n            start, end = block[0].map\n            while end > start and _is_blank(lines[end - 1]):\n                end -= 1\n            spans.append((start, end))\n    written: list[str] = []\n    at = 0\n    for start, end in spans:\n        written.extend(lines[at:start])\n        if written and not _is_blank(written[-1]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        # The token keeps the line ending of the block's last line, so that\n        # putting the block back gives its bytes exactly.\n        written.append(f\"locked-{len(locked)}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\")\n        # Its bytes exactly, less the ending of its last line.\n        locked.append(_LAST_ENDING.sub(\"\", \"\".join(lines[start:end])))\n        if end < len(lines) and not _is_blank(lines[end]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        at = end\n    written.extend(lines[at:])\n    markdown = \"\".join(written)\n    if spans and spans[-1][1] == len(lines) and not body.endswith((\"\\n\", \"\\r\")):\n        markdown = markdown.removesuffix(\"\\n\")\n    return Tokenized(markdown, tuple(locked))\n\n\ndef _token_paragraphs(markdown: str) -> list[tuple[int, int, int]]:\n    \"\"\"Where `markdown` holds a locked block's token: (first line, line after\n    the last, token number) of each top-level paragraph that is one.\"\"\"\n    return [(block[0].map[0], block[0].map[1], number)\n            for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(markdown))\n            if (number := _token_number(block)) is not None]\n\n\nUNKNOWN_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here is not in the saved \"\n                 \"version. Reload the page to get the saved version back.\")\nDUPLICATE_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here appears twice. \"\n                   \"Remove one of them.\")\n\n\ndef restore(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each token replaced by its locked block from `stored`,\n    byte for byte. A token that is missing was removed, with its block.\n    ContentError for a token `stored` has no block for, or one used twice.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    found = _token_paragraphs(markdown)\n    numbers = [number for _, _, number in found]\n    if any(number >= len(locked) for number in numbers):\n        raise ContentError(UNKNOWN_TOKEN)\n    if len(set(numbers)) != len(numbers):\n        raise ContentError(DUPLICATE_TOKEN)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in reversed(found):\n        lines[start:end] = [locked[number] + _ending(lines[end - 1])]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n# The Editor's HTML.\n\nLOCKED_NOTE = \"This part can't be edited here.\"\n\n\ndef _locked_html(number: int, locked: tuple[str, ...], image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A locked block as the Editor shows it: its rendered, sanitized HTML,\n    never its source. Its token is the only thing the Editor posts back.\"\"\"\n    shown = render_markdown(locked[number], image_src) if number < len(locked) else \"\"\n    return (f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked\" data-locked=\"locked-{number}\">'\n            f'<p class=\"admin-editor-locked-note\">{escape(LOCKED_NOTE)}</p>'\n            f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked-shown\">{shown}</div></div>')\n\n\ndef editor_html(markdown: str, stored: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> Markup:\n    \"\"\"What the Editor shows for `markdown`, a tokenized body (usually\n    tokenize(stored).markdown), whose tokens are `stored`'s locked blocks.\n    Rendered and sanitized as the site renders it, with each chart image's\n    src from `image_src`.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    # Each token is swapped for a placeholder only this call knows, so that\n    # nothing the writer typed can render as one.\n    nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in _token_paragraphs(markdown):\n        lines[start:end] = [f\"locked-{nonce}-{number}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\"]\n    html = str(render_markdown(\"\".join(lines), image_src))\n    return Markup(re.sub(rf\"<p>locked-{nonce}-(\\d+)</p>\",\n                         lambda m: _locked_html(int(m[1]), locked, image_src), html))\n\n\n# What a post saves.\n\n# The Editor's HTML as nh3 lets it through, before app.markdown_form reads it:\n# only what the Editor can represent, and each locked block's token.\n_POSTED_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"strong\", \"b\", \"em\", \"i\", \"a\", \"img\", \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\",\n                \"blockquote\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"table\", \"thead\",\n                \"tbody\", \"tfoot\", \"tr\", \"th\", \"td\", \"div\", \"span\"}\n_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"},\n                      \"th\": {\"style\"}, \"td\": {\"style\"}, \"div\": {\"data-locked\"}}\n\n\ndef _sanitized(html: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(html, tags=_POSTED_TAGS, attributes=_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                     attribute_filter=table_cell_alignment, link_rel=None)\n\n\ndef _with_lf(text: str) -> str:\n    return _NEWLINE.sub(\"\\n\", text)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Posted:\n    \"\"\"A body as an edit form posts it. With the Editor, `body_html` is its\n    HTML and `body_dirty` whether the writer changed it. Without (the\n    script didn't load), `body_html` is None and `body` is the textarea's\n    Markdown: the tokenized body, as the page gave it, perhaps edited.\"\"\"\n    body: str\n    body_html: str | None\n    body_dirty: bool\n\n    def untouched(self, stored: str) -> bool:\n        if self.body_html is not None:\n            return not self.body_dirty\n        return _with_lf(self.body) == _with_lf(tokenize(stored).markdown)\n\n    def markdown(self, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The body the writer wants, tokenized. ContentError if the Editor's\n        HTML has a locked block it didn't make.\"\"\"\n        if self.body_html is None:\n            return self.body\n        return to_markdown(_sanitized(self.body_html), image_name)\n\n\ndef saved_body(posted: Posted, stored: str | None, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for `posted`, over `stored` (None for a new item). An\n    untouched body is `stored` exactly, whatever was posted; any other is the\n    posted body, in standard form if from the Editor, with its locked blocks\n    put back from `stored`. ContentError if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return stored\n    return restore(posted.markdown(image_name), stored or \"\")\n\n\n# The edit and create forms.\n\nNEEDS_BASE = \"This page is out of date. Reload it to see the latest version.\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"How the Editor shows an item's chart images, and reads them back.\"\"\"\n    src: ImageSrc\n    name: ImageName\n\n\ndef image_links(prefix: str) -> ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"For an item whose chart images the admin console serves at\n    `prefix`<name> (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/images/).\"\"\"\n    def name(src: str) -> str | None:\n        rest = src.removeprefix(prefix)\n        return unquote(rest) if src.startswith(prefix) and rest and \"/\" not in rest else None\n\n    return ImageLinks(src=lambda image: prefix + quote(image, safe=\"\"), name=name)\n\n\ndef form_for(item: Mapping) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The edit form for a stored item, as the page opens: its body\n    tokenized, and its base version.\"\"\"\n    return {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"slug\": item[\"slug\"],\n            \"body\": tokenize(item[\"body\"]).markdown,\n            \"item_base\": item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]),\n            \"body_dirty\": False}\n\n\ndef form_after(posted: Posted, title: str, slug: str, base: str, stored: str | None,\n               image_name: ImageName | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The form again after a refused save of `posted`, with what the writer\n    had, and the same base version, so a stale form stays refused.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return {**form_for({\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": stored}),\n                \"item_base\": base}\n    try:\n        body = posted.markdown(image_name)\n    except ContentError:\n        # Editor HTML it didn't make: the Editor opens on the stored body again.\n        body = tokenize(stored or \"\").markdown\n    return {\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body, \"item_base\": base, \"body_dirty\": True}\n\n\ndef full_body(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form's tokenized body with its locked blocks back, for the Site\n    preview; as it is if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return restore(markdown, stored)\n    except ContentError:\n        return markdown\n\n\ndef saved_edit(posted: Posted, item: Mapping, base: str, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for an edit of the stored `item` from a form opened\n    on `base`. StaleItem if the item has changed since; ContentError if the\n    Editor posted without a base version, or as saved_body. Old forms and\n    scripts that post no base, and no Editor HTML, are not checked.\"\"\"\n    if base and base != item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]):\n        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n    if posted.body_html is not None and not base:\n        raise ContentError(NEEDS_BASE)\n    return saved_body(posted, item[\"body\"], image_name)\n\"\"\"Editor HTML to Markdown in its standard form (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe Editor posts HTML; the body is stored as Markdown. app.editor sanitizes\nthe posted HTML with nh3 first, and this module turns what is left into\nMarkdown, written one standard way, with stdlib `html.parser`. It writes only\nwhat the Editor supports: paragraphs, Sections (H2) and Subsections (H3),\nbulleted and numbered lists, block quotes, tables, and bold, italic, line\nbreaks, `https:`/`mailto:` links, and chart images inline. Any other element\nis let through as its text. Everything the writer typed is escaped, so it\nrenders as the text it is and never as Markdown syntax.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n\nfrom app.content import ContentError\n\n# A locked block's token (app.editor): on its own, a top-level paragraph that\n# the stored block is put back in place of. The Editor shows the block as an\n# empty <div data-locked=\"locked-<n>\">, and it is written as its token.\nLOCKED_TOKEN = re.compile(r\"locked-(\\d+)\")\n_LOCKED = \"data-locked\"\n_LOCKED_MOVED = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here was moved into a list, \"\n                 \"quote, table, or paragraph. Move it back, or remove it.\")\n_LOCKED_FORGED = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here was changed. Reload the \"\n                  \"page to get it back.\")\n\n# An <img>'s src -> the name of the item's chart image it shows; None for\n# any other picture, which is dropped.\nImageName = Callable[[str], \"str | None\"]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass _Element:\n    tag: str\n    attrs: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    children: list[_Element | str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n\n# Elements with no end tag, which never hold children.\n_VOID = {\"br\", \"img\", \"hr\", \"input\", \"meta\", \"link\", \"wbr\", \"col\", \"source\"}\n# Elements whose content is never text for the body (nh3 drops them too).\n_SKIPPED = {\"script\", \"style\", \"template\", \"head\", \"title\"}\n\n\nclass _TreeBuilder(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"The HTML as a tree of _Elements. Forgiving: an end tag closes the\n    nearest open element of its name, and one with none open is ignored.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.root = _Element(\"root\")\n        self._open = [self.root]\n        self._skipping = 0\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if self._skipping or tag in _SKIPPED:\n            self._skipping += tag not in _VOID\n            return\n        element = _Element(tag, {name: value or \"\" for name, value in attrs})\n        self._open[-1].children.append(element)\n        if tag not in _VOID:\n            self._open.append(element)\n\n    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if not self._skipping and tag not in _SKIPPED:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(_Element(tag, {n: v or \"\" for n, v in attrs}))\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n        if self._skipping:\n            self._skipping -= tag in _SKIPPED or 0\n            return\n        for depth in range(len(self._open) - 1, 0, -1):\n            if self._open[depth].tag == tag:\n                del self._open[depth:]\n                return\n\n    def handle_data(self, data):\n        if not self._skipping:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(data)\n\n\ndef _tree(html: str) -> _Element:\n    builder = _TreeBuilder()\n    builder.feed(html)\n    builder.close()\n    return builder.root\n\n\n# Every ASCII punctuation character that can start Markdown syntax anywhere in\n# a line. A backslash before any ASCII punctuation is always a literal.\n_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\`*_\\[\\]<>&|#~!])\")\n_WHITESPACE = re.compile(r\"[ \\t\\n\\r\\f]+\")\n# At the start of a line, the syntax that _ESCAPED leaves alone: a list\n# marker, a setext underline, or a numbered list's \"1.\" or \"1)\".\n_LINE_START = re.compile(r\"^(?:([-+=])|(\\d+)([.)]))\")\n# In a link's destination: what would end it early, and what Markdown would\n# otherwise read as an escape or an entity.\n_DESTINATION_ENCODED = re.compile(r\"[\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]\")\n_DESTINATION_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\()&])\")\n# The only links the Editor keeps (spec #14, \"Links\"); a site link is T14's.\nLINK_SCHEMES = (\"https:\", \"mailto:\")\n\n# A line break, in inline Markdown before it is split into lines. Writer text\n# never holds one: _escape turns every newline into a space.\n_BREAK = \"\\n\"\n_BOLD = {\"strong\", \"b\"}\n_ITALIC = {\"em\", \"i\"}\n\n# The title is the page's only H1, so a pasted H1 becomes a Section; the\n# Editor has no level below a Subsection.\n_HEADING_LEVELS = {\"h1\": 2, \"h2\": 2, \"h3\": 3, \"h4\": 3, \"h5\": 3, \"h6\": 3}\n_LISTS = {\"ul\", \"ol\"}\n_TABLE_SECTIONS = {\"thead\", \"tbody\", \"tfoot\"}\n_CELLS = {\"th\", \"td\"}\n# Elements that hold blocks, not inline text. Any other element is inline;\n# one the Editor doesn't write (a <div> or <section> from a paste) is a\n# wrapper, and only what is in it is kept.\n_BLOCK_TAGS = {\"p\", \"blockquote\", \"table\", \"hr\", \"pre\", \"li\", \"tr\", \"caption\",\n               *_LISTS, *_HEADING_LEVELS, *_TABLE_SECTIONS, *_CELLS,\n               \"div\", \"section\", \"article\", \"header\", \"footer\", \"main\", \"aside\", \"nav\",\n               \"figure\", \"figcaption\", \"address\", \"details\", \"summary\", \"dl\", \"dt\", \"dd\",\n               \"center\"}\n_ALIGNMENTS = {\"text-align:left\": \":--\", \"text-align:right\": \"--:\",\n               \"text-align:center\": \":-:\"}\n\n\ndef _escape(text: str) -> str:\n    return _ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", _WHITESPACE.sub(\" \", text))\n\n\ndef _escape_line_start(line: str) -> str:\n    return _LINE_START.sub(lambda m: f\"\\\\{m[1]}\" if m[1] else f\"{m[2]}\\\\{m[3]}\", line)\n\n\ndef _destination(url: str) -> str:\n    url = _DESTINATION_ENCODED.sub(lambda m: f\"%{ord(m[0]):02X}\", url)\n    return _DESTINATION_ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", url)\n\n\ndef _is_block(node: _Element | str) -> bool:\n    return isinstance(node, _Element) and (node.tag in _BLOCK_TAGS or _LOCKED in node.attrs)\n\n\ndef _locked_token(node: _Element) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token of a locked block as the Editor posts it: empty, since what\n    it shows is only for display and what is saved comes from the stored\n    body. Anything else was not made by the Editor.\"\"\"\n    token = node.attrs[_LOCKED]\n    if not LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(token) or any(\n            isinstance(child, _Element) or child.strip() for child in node.children):\n        raise ContentError(_LOCKED_FORGED)\n    return token\n\n\ndef _indent(text: str, first: str, rest: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text` with `first` before its first line and `rest` before each\n    other non-empty line.\"\"\"\n    lines = text.split(\"\\n\")\n    return \"\\n\".join([first + lines[0], *(rest + line if line else \"\" for line in lines[1:])])\n\n\ndef _start(ol: _Element) -> int:\n    start = ol.attrs.get(\"start\", \"1\").strip()\n    return int(start) if start.isdigit() and len(start) <= 9 else 1\n\n\ndef _items(listing: _Element) -> list[list[_Element | str]]:\n    \"\"\"A list's items, each as its children. A list put straight inside a\n    list, not in an item (as some browsers indent), belongs to the item\n    before it.\"\"\"\n    items: list[list[_Element | str]] = []\n    for child in listing.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"li\":\n            items.append(list(child.children))\n        elif isinstance(child, _Element) or child.strip():\n            if not items:\n                items.append([])\n            items[-1].append(child)\n    return items\n\n\ndef _rows(table: _Element) -> list[_Element]:\n    \"\"\"A table's rows, in order, from its sections or straight inside it.\"\"\"\n    rows = []\n    for child in table.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"tr\":\n            rows.append(child)\n        elif isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag in _TABLE_SECTIONS:\n            rows.extend(row for row in child.children\n                        if isinstance(row, _Element) and row.tag == \"tr\")\n    return rows\n\n\ndef _without_breaks(node: _Element | str) -> _Element | str:\n    \"\"\"A table cell's content with each line break as a space: a Markdown\n    table row is one line.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(node, str):\n        return node\n    if node.tag == \"br\":\n        return \" \"\n    return _Element(node.tag, node.attrs, [_without_breaks(child) for child in node.children])\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass _Converter:\n    image_name: ImageName | None\n    # Off in a table cell, where a line never starts a block.\n    escape_line_starts: bool = True\n\n    # Inline.\n\n    def inline(self, node: _Element | str, marks: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> str:\n        \"\"\"One node's inline Markdown. `marks` are what is already open\n        around it (\"bold\", \"italic\", \"link\"), so none is written twice.\"\"\"\n        if isinstance(node, str):\n            return _escape(node)\n        if _LOCKED in node.attrs:\n            raise ContentError(_LOCKED_MOVED)\n        if node.tag == \"br\":\n            return _BREAK\n        if node.tag == \"img\":\n            return self.image(node)\n        if node.tag in _BOLD:\n            return self.delimit(\"**\", node, marks, \"bold\")\n        if node.tag in _ITALIC:\n            return self.delimit(\"*\", node, marks, \"italic\")\n        if node.tag == \"a\":\n            return self.link(node, marks)\n        return self.content(node, marks)\n\n    def content(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        return \"\".join(self.inline(child, marks) for child in node.children)\n\n    def delimit(self, marker: str, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str], mark: str) -> str:\n        content = self.content(node, marks | {mark})\n        core = content.strip(\" \")\n        if mark in marks or not core:\n            return content\n        # Markdown only opens and closes emphasis next to non-space characters.\n        lead = content[:len(content) - len(content.lstrip(\" \"))]\n        trail = content[len(content.rstrip(\" \")):]\n        return f\"{lead}{marker}{core}{marker}{trail}\"\n\n    def link(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        text = self.content(node, marks | {\"link\"})\n        href = node.attrs.get(\"href\", \"\").strip()\n        if \"link\" in marks or not text.strip() or not href.lower().startswith(LINK_SCHEMES):\n            return text\n        return f\"[{text}]({_destination(href)})\"\n\n    def image(self, node: _Element) -> str:\n        name = self.image_name(node.attrs.get(\"src\", \"\")) if self.image_name else None\n        if name is None:\n            return \"\"\n        return f\"![{_escape(node.attrs.get('alt', ''))}]({_destination('image:' + name)})\"\n\n    def lines(self, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Inline nodes as lines of Markdown, split at line breaks, with no\n        empty line at either end.\"\"\"\n        lines = [line.strip(\" \")\n                 for line in \"\".join(self.inline(node) for node in nodes).split(_BREAK)]\n        if self.escape_line_starts:\n            lines = list(map(_escape_line_start, lines))\n        while lines and not lines[-1]:\n            lines.pop()\n        while lines and not lines[0]:\n            lines.pop(0)\n        return lines\n\n    # Blocks.\n\n    def blocks(self, element: _Element, *, top: bool = False) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"An element's children as Markdown blocks, in order. A run of\n        inline children between blocks is a paragraph. Only the `top`, the\n        body itself, may hold a locked block.\"\"\"\n        blocks: list[str | None] = []\n        run: list[_Element | str] = []\n        # The marker of the list just written, if the last block is a list:\n        # Its first row is the header, and each\n        column is aligned as its header cell is.\"\"\"\n        rows = [[cell for cell in row.children if isinstance(cell, _Element)\n                 and cell.tag in _CELLS] for row in _rows(table)]\n        width = max(map(len, rows), default=0)\n        if not width:\n            return None\n        text = [[self.cell(cell) for cell in row] + [\"\"] * (width - len(row)) for row in rows]\n        header = rows[0] + [None]","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"returnCodeInterpretation":"No matches found","noOutputExpected":false,"persistedOutputPath":"/Users/davelleat/.claude/projects/-Users-davelleat-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/5f1453e3-22ca-48ab-bcdf-08e3c322f1be/tool-results/bv5h7gja2.txt","persistedOutputSize":30838},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"ec579a55-30da-49bc-87cf-72a8a0931f7d","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":4},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a199f640-baac-47a8-afc6-35c952dc7993","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"5f1453e3-22ca-48ab-bcdf-08e3c322f1be","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"f8008c36-4df4-42f0-a41e-cb1190b9c3ba","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"0620594e-4d98-4377-a0b2-f29d0c1d1779","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01QMopLTrHmr9MnyZcAXGPAQ","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The Editor's server side (spec #14, ADR-005).\n2\t\n3\tThe body is stored as Markdown. The Editor shows it as HTML and posts HTML\n4\tback, which app.markdown_form turns into Markdown again. This module decides\n5\twhat the Editor is shown, and what a posted body saves.\n6\t\n7\t**Locked blocks.** A top-level block of the stored body that the Editor can't\n8\trepresent (a code block, raw HTML, an inline code span, ...) is *locked*: it\n9\tis cut out and replaced by the token `locked-<n>` (n: its place among the\n10\tbody's locked blocks), and the Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML,\n11\tread-only. Its Markdown source never reaches the browser. On save, each token\n12\tis replaced by that block's source from the *stored* body, never from\n13\tanything posted.\n14\t\"\"\"\n15\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n16\t\n17\timport re\n18\timport secrets\n19\tfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n20\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n21\tfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n22\t\n23\timport nh3\n24\tfrom markdown_it.token import Token\n25\tfrom markupsafe import Markup, escape\n26\t\n27\tfrom app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\n28\tfrom app.markdown_form import LINK_SCHEMES, LOCKED_TOKEN, ImageName, to_markdown\n29\tfrom app.rendering import (IMAGE_REFERENCE, ImageSrc, parse, render_markdown,\n30\t                           table_cell_alignment)\n31\t\n32\t# Block tokens the Editor can represent, and the headings among them.\n33\t_SUPPORTED_BLOCKS = {\n34\t    \"paragraph_open\", \"paragraph_close\", \"heading_open\", \"heading_close\", \"inline\",\n35\t    \"bullet_list_open\", \"bullet_list_close\", \"ordered_list_open\", \"ordered_list_close\",\n36\t    \"list_item_open\", \"list_item_close\", \"blockquote_open\", \"blockquote_close\",\n37\t    \"table_open\", \"table_close\", \"thead_open\", \"thead_close\", \"tbody_open\", \"tbody_close\",\n38\t    \"tr_open\", \"tr_close\", \"th_open\", \"th_close\", \"td_open\", \"td_close\",\n39\t}\n40\t_SUPPORTED_HEADINGS = {\"h2\", \"h3\"}\n41\t_SUPPORTED_INLINE = {\"text\", \"softbreak\", \"hardbreak\", \"strong_open\", \"strong_close\",\n42\t                     \"em_open\", \"em_close\", \"link_open\", \"link_close\", \"image\"}\n43\t_NEWLINE = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n?|\\n\")\n44\t_LAST_ENDING = re.compile(r\"(?:\\r\\n?|\\n)\\Z\")\n45\t\n46\t\n47\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n48\tclass Tokenized:\n49\t    \"\"\"A body with each locked block replaced by its token.\"\"\"\n50\t    markdown: str\n51\t    # The locked blocks' Markdown source, by token number.\n52\t    locked: tuple[str, ...]\n53\t\n54\t\n55\tdef _supported_inline(token: Token) -> bool:\n56\t    if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_INLINE:\n57\t        return False\n58\t    if token.type == \"link_open\":\n59\t        return (str(token.attrGet(\"href\")).lower().startswith(LINK_SCHEMES)\n60\t                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None)\n61\t    if token.type == \"image\":\n62\t        return (str(token.attrGet(\"src\")).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE)\n63\t                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n64\t                and all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])))\n65\t    return True\n66\t\n67\t\n68\tdef _token_number(block: list[Token]) -> int | None:\n69\t    \"\"\"The number of the token a top-level block is, if it is a paragraph\n70\t    holding nothing but one.\"\"\"\n71\t    if [token.type for token in block] != [\"paragraph_open\", \"inline\", \"paragraph_close\"]:\n72\t        return None\n73\t    match = LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(block[1].content)\n74\t    return int(match[1]) if match else None\n75\t\n76\t\n77\tdef _supported(block: list[Token]) -> bool:\n78\t    \"\"\"Whether the Editor can represent a top-level block, given as its\n79\t    tokens: it and everything in it.\"\"\"\n80\t    if _token_number(block) is not None:\n81\t        # Text that reads as a token; locked, so it is never taken for one.\n82\t        return False\n83\t    for token in block:\n84\t        if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_BLOCKS:\n85\t            return False\n86\t        if token.type == \"heading_open\" and token.tag not in _SUPPORTED_HEADINGS:\n87\t            return False\n88\t        if token.type == \"inline\" and not all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])):\n89\t            return False\n90\t    return True\n91\t\n92\t\n93\tdef _top_level_blocks(tokens: list[Token]) -> list[list[Token]]:\n94\t    \"\"\"The tokens of each top-level block, in order.\"\"\"\n95\t    blocks: list[list[Token]] = []\n96\t    depth = 0\n97\t    for token in tokens:\n98\t        if depth == 0:\n99\t            blocks.append([])\n100\t        blocks[-1].append(token)\n101\t        depth += token.nesting\n102\t    return blocks\n103\t\n104\t\n105\tdef _lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n106\t    \"\"\"`text`'s lines, each with its line ending, numbered as markdown-it\n107\t    numbers them (it reads \\\\r\\\\n and \\\\r as \\\\n).\"\"\"\n108\t    parts = _NEWLINE.split(text)\n109\t    endings = _NEWLINE.findall(text)\n110\t    lines = [part + ending for part, ending in zip(parts, endings)]\n111\t    return lines + [parts[-1]] if parts[-1] else lines\n112\t\n113\t\n114\tdef _ending(line: str) -> str:\n115\t    return line[len(line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")):] or \"\\n\"\n116\t\n117\t\n118\tdef _is_blank(line: str) -> bool:\n119\t    return not line.strip()\n120\t\n121\t\n122\tdef tokenize(body: str) -> Tokenized:\n123\t    \"\"\"`body` with each locked block replaced by its token, on a line of its\n124\t    own with a blank line either side.\"\"\"\n125\t    lines = _lines(body)\n126\t    locked: list[str] = []\n127\t    # (first line, line after the last) of each locked block.\n128\t    spans = []\n129\t    for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(body)):\n130\t        if block[0].map and not _supported(block):\n131\t            start, end = block[0].map\n132\t            while end > start and _is_blank(lines[end - 1]):\n133\t                end -= 1\n134\t            spans.append((start, end))\n135\t    written: list[str] = []\n136\t    at = 0\n137\t    for start, end in spans:\n138\t        written.extend(lines[at:start])\n139\t        if written and not _is_blank(written[-1]):\n140\t            written.append(\"\\n\")\n141\t        # The token keeps the line ending of the block's last line, so that\n142\t        # putting the block back gives its bytes exactly.\n143\t        written.append(f\"locked-{len(locked)}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\")\n144\t        # Its bytes exactly, less the ending of its last line.\n145\t        locked.append(_LAST_ENDING.sub(\"\", \"\".join(lines[start:end])))\n146\t        if end < len(lines) and not _is_blank(lines[end]):\n147\t            written.append(\"\\n\")\n148\t        at = end\n149\t    written.extend(lines[at:])\n150\t    markdown = \"\".join(written)\n151\t    if spans and spans[-1][1] == len(lines) and not body.endswith((\"\\n\", \"\\r\")):\n152\t        markdown = markdown.removesuffix(\"\\n\")\n153\t    return Tokenized(markdown, tuple(locked))\n154\t\n155\t\n156\tdef _token_paragraphs(markdown: str) -> list[tuple[int, int, int]]:\n157\t    \"\"\"Where `markdown` holds a locked block's token: (first line, line after\n158\t    the last, token number) of each top-level paragraph that is one.\"\"\"\n159\t    return [(block[0].map[0], block[0].map[1], number)\n160\t            for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(markdown))\n161\t            if (number := _token_number(block)) is not None]\n162\t\n163\t\n164\tUNKNOWN_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here is not in the saved \"\n165\t                 \"version. Reload the page to get the saved version back.\")\n166\tDUPLICATE_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here appears twice. \"\n167\t                   \"Remove one of them.\")\n168\t\n169\t\n170\tdef restore(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n171\t    \"\"\"`markdown` with each token replaced by its locked block from `stored`,\n172\t    byte for byte. A token that is missing was removed, with its block.\n173\t    ContentError for a token `stored` has no block for, or one used twice.\"\"\"\n174\t    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n175\t    found = _token_paragraphs(markdown)\n176\t    numbers = [number for _, _, number in found]\n177\t    if any(number >= len(locked) for number in numbers):\n178\t        raise ContentError(UNKNOWN_TOKEN)\n179\t    if len(set(numbers)) != len(numbers):\n180\t        raise ContentError(DUPLICATE_TOKEN)\n181\t    lines = _lines(markdown)\n182\t    for start, end, number in reversed(found):\n183\t        lines[start:end] = [locked[number] + _ending(lines[end - 1])]\n184\t    return \"\".join(lines)\n185\t\n186\t\n187\t# The Editor's HTML.\n188\t\n189\tLOCKED_NOTE = \"This part can't be edited here.\"\n190\t\n191\t\n192\tdef _locked_html(number: int, locked: tuple[str, ...], image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> str:\n193\t    \"\"\"A locked block as the Editor shows it: its rendered, sanitized HTML,\n194\t    never its source. Its token is the only thing the Editor posts back.\"\"\"\n195\t    shown = render_markdown(locked[number], image_src) if number < len(locked) else \"\"\n196\t    return (f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked\" data-locked=\"locked-{number}\">'\n197\t            f'<p class=\"admin-editor-locked-note\">{escape(LOCKED_NOTE)}</p>'\n198\t            f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked-shown\">{shown}</div></div>')\n199\t\n200\t\n201\tdef editor_html(markdown: str, stored: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> Markup:\n202\t    \"\"\"What the Editor shows for `markdown`, a tokenized body (usually\n203\t    tokenize(stored).markdown), whose tokens are `stored`'s locked blocks.\n204\t    Rendered and sanitized as the site renders it, with each chart image's\n205\t    src from `image_src`.\"\"\"\n206\t    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n207\t    # Each token is swapped for a placeholder only this call knows, so that\n208\t    # nothing the writer typed can render as one.\n209\t    nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)\n210\t    lines = _lines(markdown)\n211\t    for start, end, number in _token_paragraphs(markdown):\n212\t        lines[start:end] = [f\"locked-{nonce}-{number}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\"]\n213\t    html = str(render_markdown(\"\".join(lines), image_src))\n214\t    return Markup(re.sub(rf\"<p>locked-{nonce}-(\\d+)</p>\",\n215\t                         lambda m: _locked_html(int(m[1]), locked, image_src), html))\n216\t\n217\t\n218\t# What a post saves.\n219\t\n220\t# The Editor's HTML as nh3 lets it through, before app.markdown_form reads it:\n221\t# only what the Editor can represent, and each locked block's token.\n222\t_POSTED_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"strong\", \"b\", \"em\", \"i\", \"a\", \"img\", \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\",\n223\t                \"blockquote\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"table\", \"thead\",\n224\t                \"tbody\", \"tfoot\", \"tr\", \"th\", \"td\", \"div\", \"span\"}\n225\t_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"},\n226\t                      \"th\": {\"style\"}, \"td\": {\"style\"}, \"div\": {\"data-locked\"}}\n227\t\n228\t\n229\tdef _sanitized(html: str) -> str:\n230\t    return nh3.clean(html, tags=_POSTED_TAGS, attributes=_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES,\n231\t                     attribute_filter=table_cell_alignment, link_rel=None)\n232\t\n233\t\n234\tdef _with_lf(text: str) -> str:\n235\t    return _NEWLINE.sub(\"\\n\", text)\n236\t\n237\t\n238\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n239\tclass Posted:\n240\t    \"\"\"A body as an edit form posts it. With the Editor, `body_html` is its\n241\t    HTML and `body_dirty` whether the writer changed it. Without (the\n242\t    script didn't load), `body_html` is None and `body` is the textarea's\n243\t    Markdown: the tokenized body, as the page gave it, perhaps edited.\"\"\"\n244\t    body: str\n245\t    body_html: str | None\n246\t    body_dirty: bool\n247\t\n248\t    def untouched(self, stored: str) -> bool:\n249\t        if self.body_html is not None:\n250\t            return not self.body_dirty\n251\t        return _with_lf(self.body) == _with_lf(tokenize(stored).markdown)\n252\t\n253\t    def markdown(self, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n254\t        \"\"\"The body the writer wants, tokenized. ContentError if the Editor's\n255\t        HTML has a locked block it didn't make.\"\"\"\n256\t        if self.body_html is None:\n257\t            return self.body\n258\t        return to_markdown(_sanitized(self.body_html), image_name)\n259\t\n260\t\n261\tdef saved_body(posted: Posted, stored: str | None, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n262\t    \"\"\"The body to save for `posted`, over `stored` (None for a new item). An\n263\t    untouched body is `stored` exactly, whatever was posted; any other is the\n264\t    posted body, in standard form if from the Editor, with its locked blocks\n265\t    put back from `stored`. ContentError if it can't be.\"\"\"\n266\t    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n267\t        return stored\n268\t    return restore(posted.markdown(image_name), stored or \"\")\n269\t\n270\t\n271\t# The edit and create forms.\n272\t\n273\tNEEDS_BASE = \"This page is out of date. Reload it to see the latest version.\"\n274\t\n275\t\n276\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n277\tclass ImageLinks:\n278\t    \"\"\"How the Editor shows an item's chart images, and reads them back.\"\"\"\n279\t    src: ImageSrc\n280\t    name: ImageName\n281\t\n282\t\n283\tdef image_links(prefix: str) -> ImageLinks:\n284\t    \"\"\"For an item whose chart images the admin console serves at\n285\t    `prefix`<name> (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/images/).\"\"\"\n286\t    def name(src: str) -> str | None:\n287\t        rest = src.removeprefix(prefix)\n288\t        return unquote(rest) if src.startswith(prefix) and rest and \"/\" not in rest else None\n289\t\n290\t    return ImageLinks(src=lambda image: prefix + quote(image, safe=\"\"), name=name)\n291\t\n292\t\n293\tdef form_for(item: Mapping) -> dict:\n294\t    \"\"\"The edit form for a stored item, as the page opens: its body\n295\t    tokenized, and its base version.\"\"\"\n296\t    return {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"slug\": item[\"slug\"],\n297\t            \"body\": tokenize(item[\"body\"]).markdown,\n298\t            \"item_base\": item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]),\n299\t            \"body_dirty\": False}\n300\t\n301\t\n302\tdef form_after(posted: Posted, title: str, slug: str, base: str, stored: str | None,\n303\t               image_name: ImageName | None) -> dict:\n304\t    \"\"\"The form again after a refused save of `posted`, with what the writer\n305\t    had, and the same base version, so a stale form stays refused.\"\"\"\n306\t    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n307\t        return {**form_for({\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": stored}),\n308\t                \"item_base\": base}\n309\t    try:\n310\t        body = posted.markdown(image_name)\n311\t    except ContentError:\n312\t        # Editor HTML it didn't make: the Editor opens on the stored body again.\n313\t        body = tokenize(stored or \"\").markdown\n314\t    return {\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body, \"item_base\": base, \"body_dirty\": True}\n315\t\n316\t\n317\tdef full_body(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n318\t    \"\"\"A form's tokenized body with its locked blocks back, for the Site\n319\t    preview; as it is if it can't be.\"\"\"\n320\t    try:\n321\t        return restore(markdown, stored)\n322\t    except ContentError:\n323\t        return markdown\n324\t\n325\t\n326\tdef saved_edit(posted: Posted, item: Mapping, base: str, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n327\t    \"\"\"The body to save for an edit of the stored `item` from a form opened\n328\t    on `base`. StaleItem if the item has changed since; ContentError if the\n329\t    Editor posted without a base version, or as saved_body. Old forms and\n330\t    scripts that post no base, and no Editor HTML, are not checked.\"\"\"\n331\t    if base and base != item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]):\n332\t        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n333\t    if posted.body_html is not None and not base:\n334\t        raise ContentError(NEEDS_BASE)\n335\t    return saved_body(posted, item[\"body\"], image_name)\n336\t"}]},"uuid":"9c8dbcf6-43b1-4700-b811-41669638476c","timestamp":"2026-09-30T21:23:10.460Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/editor.py","content":"\"\"\"The Editor's server side (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe body is stored as Markdown. The Editor shows it as HTML and posts HTML\nback, which app.markdown_form turns into Markdown again. This module decides\nwhat the Editor is shown, and what a posted body saves.\n\n**Locked blocks.** A top-level block of the stored body that the Editor can't\nrepresent (a code block, raw HTML, an inline code span, ...) is *locked*: it\nis cut out and replaced by the token `locked-<n>` (n: its place among the\nbody's locked blocks), and the Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML,\nread-only. Its Markdown source never reaches the browser. On save, each token\nis replaced by that block's source from the *stored* body, never from\nanything posted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markupsafe import Markup, escape\n\nfrom app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\nfrom app.markdown_form import LINK_SCHEMES, LOCKED_TOKEN, ImageName, to_markdown\nfrom app.rendering import (IMAGE_REFERENCE, ImageSrc, parse, render_markdown,\n                           table_cell_alignment)\n\n# Block tokens the Editor can represent, and the headings among them.\n_SUPPORTED_BLOCKS = {\n    \"paragraph_open\", \"paragraph_close\", \"heading_open\", \"heading_close\", \"inline\",\n    \"bullet_list_open\", \"bullet_list_close\", \"ordered_list_open\", \"ordered_list_close\",\n    \"list_item_open\", \"list_item_close\", \"blockquote_open\", \"blockquote_close\",\n    \"table_open\", \"table_close\", \"thead_open\", \"thead_close\", \"tbody_open\", \"tbody_close\",\n    \"tr_open\", \"tr_close\", \"th_open\", \"th_close\", \"td_open\", \"td_close\",\n}\n_SUPPORTED_HEADINGS = {\"h2\", \"h3\"}\n_SUPPORTED_INLINE = {\"text\", \"softbreak\", \"hardbreak\", \"strong_open\", \"strong_close\",\n                     \"em_open\", \"em_close\", \"link_open\", \"link_close\", \"image\"}\n_NEWLINE = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n?|\\n\")\n_LAST_ENDING = re.compile(r\"(?:\\r\\n?|\\n)\\Z\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"A body with each locked block replaced by its token.\"\"\"\n    markdown: str\n    # The locked blocks' Markdown source, by token number.\n    locked: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\ndef _supported_inline(token: Token) -> bool:\n    if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_INLINE:\n        return False\n    if token.type == \"link_open\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"href\")).lower().startswith(LINK_SCHEMES)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None)\n    if token.type == \"image\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"src\")).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n                and all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])))\n    return True\n\n\ndef _token_number(block: list[Token]) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"The number of the token a top-level block is, if it is a paragraph\n    holding nothing but one.\"\"\"\n    if [token.type for token in block] != [\"paragraph_open\", \"inline\", \"paragraph_close\"]:\n        return None\n    match = LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(block[1].content)\n    return int(match[1]) if match else None\n\n\ndef _supported(block: list[Token]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether the Editor can represent a top-level block, given as its\n    tokens: it and everything in it.\"\"\"\n    if _token_number(block) is not None:\n        # Text that reads as a token; locked, so it is never taken for one.\n        return False\n    for token in block:\n        if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_BLOCKS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"heading_open\" and token.tag not in _SUPPORTED_HEADINGS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"inline\" and not all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])):\n            return False\n    return True\n\n\ndef _top_level_blocks(tokens: list[Token]) -> list[list[Token]]:\n    \"\"\"The tokens of each top-level block, in order.\"\"\"\n    blocks: list[list[Token]] = []\n    depth = 0\n    for token in tokens:\n        if depth == 0:\n            blocks.append([])\n        blocks[-1].append(token)\n        depth += token.nesting\n    return blocks\n\n\ndef _lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"`text`'s lines, each with its line ending, numbered as markdown-it\n    numbers them (it reads \\\\r\\\\n and \\\\r as \\\\n).\"\"\"\n    parts = _NEWLINE.split(text)\n    endings = _NEWLINE.findall(text)\n    lines = [part + ending for part, ending in zip(parts, endings)]\n    return lines + [parts[-1]] if parts[-1] else lines\n\n\ndef _ending(line: str) -> str:\n    return line[len(line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")):] or \"\\n\"\n\n\ndef _is_blank(line: str) -> bool:\n    return not line.strip()\n\n\ndef tokenize(body: str) -> Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"`body` with each locked block replaced by its token, on a line of its\n    own with a blank line either side.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(body)\n    locked: list[str] = []\n    # (first line, line after the last) of each locked block.\n    spans = []\n    for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(body)):\n        if block[0].map and not _supported(block):\n            start, end = block[0].map\n            while end > start and _is_blank(lines[end - 1]):\n                end -= 1\n            spans.append((start, end))\n    written: list[str] = []\n    at = 0\n    for start, end in spans:\n        written.extend(lines[at:start])\n        if written and not _is_blank(written[-1]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        # The token keeps the line ending of the block's last line, so that\n        # putting the block back gives its bytes exactly.\n        written.append(f\"locked-{len(locked)}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\")\n        # Its bytes exactly, less the ending of its last line.\n        locked.append(_LAST_ENDING.sub(\"\", \"\".join(lines[start:end])))\n        if end < len(lines) and not _is_blank(lines[end]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        at = end\n    written.extend(lines[at:])\n    markdown = \"\".join(written)\n    if spans and spans[-1][1] == len(lines) and not body.endswith((\"\\n\", \"\\r\")):\n        markdown = markdown.removesuffix(\"\\n\")\n    return Tokenized(markdown, tuple(locked))\n\n\ndef _token_paragraphs(markdown: str) -> list[tuple[int, int, int]]:\n    \"\"\"Where `markdown` holds a locked block's token: (first line, line after\n    the last, token number) of each top-level paragraph that is one.\"\"\"\n    return [(block[0].map[0], block[0].map[1], number)\n            for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(markdown))\n            if (number := _token_number(block)) is not None]\n\n\nUNKNOWN_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here is not in the saved \"\n                 \"version. Reload the page to get the saved version back.\")\nDUPLICATE_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here appears twice. \"\n                   \"Remove one of them.\")\n\n\ndef restore(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each token replaced by its locked block from `stored`,\n    byte for byte. A token that is missing was removed, with its block.\n    ContentError for a token `stored` has no block for, or one used twice.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    found = _token_paragraphs(markdown)\n    numbers = [number for _, _, number in found]\n    if any(number >= len(locked) for number in numbers):\n        raise ContentError(UNKNOWN_TOKEN)\n    if len(set(numbers)) != len(numbers):\n        raise ContentError(DUPLICATE_TOKEN)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in reversed(found):\n        lines[start:end] = [locked[number] + _ending(lines[end - 1])]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n# The Editor's HTML.\n\nLOCKED_NOTE = \"This part can't be edited here.\"\n\n\ndef _locked_html(number: int, locked: tuple[str, ...], image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A locked block as the Editor shows it: its rendered, sanitized HTML,\n    never its source. Its token is the only thing the Editor posts back.\"\"\"\n    shown = render_markdown(locked[number], image_src) if number < len(locked) else \"\"\n    return (f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked\" data-locked=\"locked-{number}\">'\n            f'<p class=\"admin-editor-locked-note\">{escape(LOCKED_NOTE)}</p>'\n            f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked-shown\">{shown}</div></div>')\n\n\ndef editor_html(markdown: str, stored: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> Markup:\n    \"\"\"What the Editor shows for `markdown`, a tokenized body (usually\n    tokenize(stored).markdown), whose tokens are `stored`'s locked blocks.\n    Rendered and sanitized as the site renders it, with each chart image's\n    src from `image_src`.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    # Each token is swapped for a placeholder only this call knows, so that\n    # nothing the writer typed can render as one.\n    nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in _token_paragraphs(markdown):\n        lines[start:end] = [f\"locked-{nonce}-{number}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\"]\n    html = str(render_markdown(\"\".join(lines), image_src))\n    return Markup(re.sub(rf\"<p>locked-{nonce}-(\\d+)</p>\",\n                         lambda m: _locked_html(int(m[1]), locked, image_src), html))\n\n\n# What a post saves.\n\n# The Editor's HTML as nh3 lets it through, before app.markdown_form reads it:\n# only what the Editor can represent, and each locked block's token.\n_POSTED_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"strong\", \"b\", \"em\", \"i\", \"a\", \"img\", \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\",\n                \"blockquote\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"table\", \"thead\",\n                \"tbody\", \"tfoot\", \"tr\", \"th\", \"td\", \"div\", \"span\"}\n_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"},\n                      \"th\": {\"style\"}, \"td\": {\"style\"}, \"div\": {\"data-locked\"}}\n\n\ndef _sanitized(html: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(html, tags=_POSTED_TAGS, attributes=_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                     attribute_filter=table_cell_alignment, link_rel=None)\n\n\ndef _with_lf(text: str) -> str:\n    return _NEWLINE.sub(\"\\n\", text)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Posted:\n    \"\"\"A body as an edit form posts it. With the Editor, `body_html` is its\n    HTML and `body_dirty` whether the writer changed it. Without (the\n    script didn't load), `body_html` is None and `body` is the textarea's\n    Markdown: the tokenized body, as the page gave it, perhaps edited.\"\"\"\n    body: str\n    body_html: str | None\n    body_dirty: bool\n\n    def untouched(self, stored: str) -> bool:\n        if self.body_html is not None:\n            return not self.body_dirty\n        return _with_lf(self.body) == _with_lf(tokenize(stored).markdown)\n\n    def markdown(self, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The body the writer wants, tokenized. ContentError if the Editor's\n        HTML has a locked block it didn't make.\"\"\"\n        if self.body_html is None:\n            return self.body\n        return to_markdown(_sanitized(self.body_html), image_name)\n\n\ndef saved_body(posted: Posted, stored: str | None, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for `posted`, over `stored` (None for a new item). An\n    untouched body is `stored` exactly, whatever was posted; any other is the\n    posted body, in standard form if from the Editor, with its locked blocks\n    put back from `stored`. ContentError if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return stored\n    return restore(posted.markdown(image_name), stored or \"\")\n\n\n# The edit and create forms.\n\nNEEDS_BASE = \"This page is out of date. Reload it to see the latest version.\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"How the Editor shows an item's chart images, and reads them back.\"\"\"\n    src: ImageSrc\n    name: ImageName\n\n\ndef image_links(prefix: str) -> ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"For an item whose chart images the admin console serves at\n    `prefix`<name> (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/images/).\"\"\"\n    def name(src: str) -> str | None:\n        rest = src.removeprefix(prefix)\n        return unquote(rest) if src.startswith(prefix) and rest and \"/\" not in rest else None\n\n    return ImageLinks(src=lambda image: prefix + quote(image, safe=\"\"), name=name)\n\n\ndef form_for(item: Mapping) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The edit form for a stored item, as the page opens: its body\n    tokenized, and its base version.\"\"\"\n    return {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"slug\": item[\"slug\"],\n            \"body\": tokenize(item[\"body\"]).markdown,\n            \"item_base\": item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]),\n            \"body_dirty\": False}\n\n\ndef form_after(posted: Posted, title: str, slug: str, base: str, stored: str | None,\n               image_name: ImageName | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The form again after a refused save of `posted`, with what the writer\n    had, and the same base version, so a stale form stays refused.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return {**form_for({\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": stored}),\n                \"item_base\": base}\n    try:\n        body = posted.markdown(image_name)\n    except ContentError:\n        # Editor HTML it didn't make: the Editor opens on the stored body again.\n        body = tokenize(stored or \"\").markdown\n    return {\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body, \"item_base\": base, \"body_dirty\": True}\n\n\ndef full_body(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form's tokenized body with its locked blocks back, for the Site\n    preview; as it is if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return restore(markdown, stored)\n    except ContentError:\n        return markdown\n\n\ndef saved_edit(posted: Posted, item: Mapping, base: str, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for an edit of the stored `item` from a form opened\n    on `base`. StaleItem if the item has changed since; ContentError if the\n    Editor posted without a base version, or as saved_body. Old forms and\n    scripts that post no base, and no Editor HTML, are not checked.\"\"\"\n    if base and base != item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]):\n        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n    if posted.body_html is not None and not base:\n        raise ContentError(NEEDS_BASE)\n    return saved_body(posted, item[\"body\"], image_name)\n","numLines":336,"startLine":1,"totalLines":336}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f8008c36-4df4-42f0-a41e-cb1190b9c3ba","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"5f1453e3-22ca-48ab-bcdf-08e3c322f1be","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"8e73ed72-bec5-4782-ba5b-2fcfec62e3e8","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"0620594e-4d98-4377-a0b2-f29d0c1d1779","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_019ai112XirB62KBvWsN9w2n","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Editor HTML to Markdown in its standard form (spec #14, ADR-005).\n2\t\n3\tThe Editor posts HTML; the body is stored as Markdown. app.editor sanitizes\n4\tthe posted HTML with nh3 first, and this module turns what is left into\n5\tMarkdown, written one standard way, with stdlib `html.parser`. It writes only\n6\twhat the Editor supports: paragraphs, Sections (H2) and Subsections (H3),\n7\tbulleted and numbered lists, block quotes, tables, and bold, italic, line\n8\tbreaks, `https:`/`mailto:` links, and chart images inline. A backslash before any ASCII punctuation is always a literal.\n_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\`*_\\[\\]<>&|#~!])\")\n_WHITESPACE = re.compile(r\"[ \\t\\n\\r\\f]+\")\n# At the start of a line, the syntax that _ESCAPED leaves alone: a list\n# marker, a setext underline, or a numbered list's \"1.\" or \"1)\".\n_LINE_START = re.compile(r\"^(?:([-+=])|(\\d+)([.)]))\")\n# In a link's destination: what would end it early, and what Markdown would\n# otherwise read as an escape or an entity.\n_DESTINATION_ENCODED = re.compile(r\"[\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]\")\n_DESTINATION_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\()&])\")\n# The only links the Editor keeps (spec #14, \"Links\"); a site link is T14's.\nLINK_SCHEMES = (\"https:\", \"mailto:\")\n\n# A line break, in inline Markdown before it is split into lines. Writer text\n# never holds one: _escape turns every newline into a space.\n_BREAK = \"\\n\"\n_BOLD = {\"strong\", \"b\"}\n_ITALIC = {\"em\", \"i\"}\n\n# The title is the page's only H1, so a pasted H1 becomes a Section; the\n# Editor has no level below a Subsection.\n_HEADING_LEVELS = {\"h1\": 2, \"h2\": 2, \"h3\": 3, \"h4\": 3, \"h5\": 3, \"h6\": 3}\n_LISTS = {\"ul\", \"ol\"}\n_TABLE_SECTIONS = {\"thead\", \"tbody\", \"tfoot\"}\n_CELLS = {\"th\", \"td\"}\n# Elements that hold blocks, not inline text. Any other element is inline;\n# one the Editor doesn't write (a <div> or <section> from a paste) is a\n# wrapper, and only what is in it is kept.\n_BLOCK_TAGS = {\"p\", \"blockquote\", \"table\", \"hr\", \"pre\", \"li\", \"tr\", \"caption\",\n               *_LISTS, *_HEADING_LEVELS, *_TABLE_SECTIONS, *_CELLS,\n               \"div\", \"section\", \"article\", \"header\", \"footer\", \"main\", \"aside\", \"nav\",\n               \"figure\", \"figcaption\", \"address\", \"details\", \"summary\", \"dl\", \"dt\", \"dd\",\n               \"center\"}\n_ALIGNMENTS = {\"text-align:left\": \":--\", \"text-align:right\": \"--:\",\n               \"text-align:center\": \":-:\"}\n\n\ndef _escape(text: str) -> str:\n    return _ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", _WHITESPACE.sub(\" \", text))\n\n\ndef _escape_line_start(line: str) -> str:\n    return _LINE_START.sub(lambda m: f\"\\\\{m[1]}\" if m[1] else f\"{m[2]}\\\\{m[3]}\", line)\n\n\ndef _destination(url: str) -> str:\n    url = _DESTINATION_ENCODED.sub(lambda m: f\"%{ord(m[0]):02X}\", url)\n    return _DESTINATION_ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", url)\n\n\ndef _is_block(node: _Element | str) -> bool:\n    return isinstance(node, _Element) and (node.tag in _BLOCK_TAGS or _LOCKED in node.attrs)\n\n\ndef _locked_token(node: _Element) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token of a locked block as the Editor posts it: empty, since what\n    it shows is only for display and what is saved comes from the stored\n    body. Anything else was not made by the Editor.\"\"\"\n    token = node.attrs[_LOCKED]\n    if not LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(token) or any(\n            isinstance(child, _Element) or child.strip() for child in node.children):\n        raise ContentError(_LOCKED_FORGED)\n    return token\n\n\ndef _indent(text: str, first: str, rest: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text` with `first` before its first line and `rest` before each\n    other non-empty line.\"\"\"\n    lines = text.split(\"\\n\")\n    return \"\\n\".join([first + lines[0], *(rest + line if line else \"\" for line in lines[1:])])\n\n\ndef _start(ol: _Element) -> int:\n    start = ol.attrs.get(\"start\", \"1\").strip()\n    return int(start) if start.isdigit() and len(start) <= 9 else 1\n\n\ndef _items(listing: _Element) -> list[list[_Element | str]]:\n    \"\"\"A list's items, each as its children. A list put straight inside a\n    list, not in an item (as some browsers indent), belongs to the item\n    before it.\"\"\"\n    items: list[list[_Element | str]] = []\n    for child in listing.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"li\":\n            items.append(list(child.children))\n        elif isinstance(child, _Element) or child.strip():\n            if not items:\n                items.append([])\n            items[-1].append(child)\n    return items\n\n\ndef _rows(table: _Element) -> list[_Element]:\n    \"\"\"A table's rows, in order, from its sections or straight inside it.\"\"\"\n    rows = []\n    for child in table.children:\n        if isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag == \"tr\":\n            rows.append(child)\n        elif isinstance(child, _Element) and child.tag in _TABLE_SECTIONS:\n            rows.extend(row for row in child.children\n                        if isinstance(row, _Element) and row.tag == \"tr\")\n    return rows\n\n\ndef _without_breaks(node: _Element | str) -> _Element | str:\n    \"\"\"A table cell's content with each line break as a space: a Markdown\n    table row is one line.\"\"\"\n    if isinstance(node, str):\n        return node\n    if node.tag == \"br\":\n        return \" \"\n    return _Element(node.tag, node.attrs, [_without_breaks(child) for child in node.children])\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass _Converter:\n    image_name: ImageName | None\n    # Off in a table cell, where a line never starts a block.\n    escape_line_starts: bool = True\n\n    # Inline.\n\n    def inline(self, node: _Element | str, marks: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> str:\n        \"\"\"One node's inline Markdown. `marks` are what is already open\n        around it (\"bold\", \"italic\", \"link\"), so none is written twice.\"\"\"\n        if isinstance(node, str):\n            return _escape(node)\n        if _LOCKED in node.attrs:\n            raise ContentError(_LOCKED_MOVED)\n        if node.tag == \"br\":\n            return _BREAK\n        if node.tag == \"img\":\n            return self.image(node)\n        if node.tag in _BOLD:\n            return self.delimit(\"**\", node, marks, \"bold\")\n        if node.tag in _ITALIC:\n            return self.delimit(\"*\", node, marks, \"italic\")\n        if node.tag == \"a\":\n            return self.link(node, marks)\n        return self.content(node, marks)\n\n    def content(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        return \"\".join(self.inline(child, marks) for child in node.children)\n\n    def delimit(self, marker: str, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str], mark: str) -> str:\n        content = self.content(node, marks | {mark})\n        core = content.strip(\" \")\n        if mark in marks or not core:\n            return content\n        # Markdown only opens and closes emphasis next to non-space characters.\n        lead = content[:len(content) - len(content.lstrip(\" \"))]\n        trail = content[len(content.rstrip(\" \")):]\n        return f\"{lead}{marker}{core}{marker}{trail}\"\n\n    def link(self, node: _Element, marks: frozenset[str]) -> str:\n        text = self.content(node, marks | {\"link\"})\n        href = node.attrs.get(\"href\", \"\").strip()\n        if \"link\" in marks or not text.strip() or not href.lower().startswith(LINK_SCHEMES):\n            return text\n        return f\"[{text}]({_destination(href)})\"\n\n    def image(self, node: _Element) -> str:\n        name = self.image_name(node.attrs.get(\"src\", \"\")) if self.image_name else None\n        if name is None:\n            return \"\"\n        return f\"![{_escape(node.attrs.get('alt', ''))}]({_destination('image:' + name)})\"\n\n    def lines(self, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Inline nodes as lines of Markdown, split at line breaks, with no\n        empty line at either end.\"\"\"\n        lines = [line.strip(\" \")\n                 for line in \"\".join(self.inline(node) for node in nodes).split(_BREAK)]\n        if self.escape_line_starts:\n            lines = list(map(_escape_line_start, lines))\n        while lines and not lines[-1]:\n            lines.pop()\n        while lines and not lines[0]:\n            lines.pop(0)\n        return lines\n\n    # Blocks.\n\n    def blocks(self, element: _Element, *, top: bool = False) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"An element's children as Markdown blocks, in order. A run of\n        inline children between blocks is a paragraph. Only the `top`, the\n        body itself, may hold a locked block.\"\"\"\n        blocks: list[str | None] = []\n        run: list[_Element | str] = []\n        # The marker of the list just written, if the last block is a list:\n        # a list straight after another of the same kind needs the other\n        # marker, or Markdown joins the two.\n        previous_marker: str | None = None\n        for child in [*element.children, None]:\n            block = child if isinstance(child, _Element) and _is_block(child) else None\n            if child is not None and block is None:\n                run.append(child)\n                continue\n            if run and (paragraph := self.paragraph(run)) is not None:\n                blocks.append(paragraph)\n                previous_marker = None\n            run = []\n            if block is None:\n                break\n            if _LOCKED in block.attrs:\n                if not top:\n                    raise ContentError(_LOCKED_MOVED)\n                blocks.append(_locked_token(block))\n                previous_marker = None\n                continue\n            if block.tag in _LISTS:\n                ordered = block.tag == \"ol\"\n                marker = (\")\" if previous_marker == \".\" else \".\") if ordered else (\n                    \"*\" if previous_marker == \"-\" else \"-\")\n                if (written := self.list(block, marker)) is not None:\n                    blocks.append(written)\n                    previous_marker = marker\n                continue\n            previous_marker = None\n            if block.tag == \"p\":\n                blocks.append(self.paragraph(block.children))\n            elif block.tag in _HEADING_LEVELS:\n                blocks.append(self.heading(_HEADING_LEVELS[block.tag], block.children))\n            elif block.tag == \"blockquote\":\n                blocks.append(self.quote(block))\n            elif block.tag == \"table\":\n                blocks.append(self.table(block))\n            else:\n                blocks.extend(self.blocks(block))\n        return [written for written in blocks if written is not None]\n\n    def paragraph(self, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n        # A backslash at the end of a line is a line break.\n        text = \"\\\\\\n\".join(self.lines(nodes))\n        if LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(text):\n            # Writer text, not a token: \"locked\\-0\" renders as \"locked-0\".\n            text = text.replace(\"-\", \"\\\\-\", 1)\n        return text or None\n\n    def heading(self, level: int, nodes: list[_Element | str]) -> str | None:\n        # A heading is one line: a line break in it is a space.\n        text = \" \".join(self.lines(nodes))\n        return f\"{'#' * level} {text}\" if text else None\n\n    def list(self, listing: _Element, marker: str) -> str | None:\n        items = _items(listing)\n        if not items:\n            return None\n        # A list whose items hold paragraphs is loose: blank lines between\n        # its items and their blocks, which Markdown renders as <p>s again.\n        loose = any(isinstance(node, _Element) and node.tag == \"p\"\n                    for item in items for node in item)\n        separator = \"\\n\\n\" if loose else \"\\n\"\n        number = _start(listing)\n        written = []\n        for item in items:\n            prefix = f\"{number}{marker} \" if marker in \".)\" else f\"{marker} \"\n            number += 1\n            content = separator.join(self.blocks(_Element(\"li\", children=item)))\n            written.append(_indent(content, prefix, \" \" * len(prefix)) if content\n                           else prefix.rstrip())\n        return separator.join(written)\n\n    def quote(self, quote: _Element) -> str | None:\n        blocks = self.blocks(quote)\n        if not blocks:\n            return None\n        return \"\\n\".join(f\"> {line}\" if line else \">\"\n                         for line in \"\\n\\n\".join(blocks).split(\"\\n\"))\n\n    def cell(self, cell: _Element) -> str:\n        content = _Element(cell.tag, cell.attrs, [_without_breaks(node) for node in cell.children])\n        blocks = replace(self, escape_line_starts=False).blocks(content)\n        return \" \".join(line.strip() for block in blocks for line in block.split(\"\\n\")\n                        if line.strip())\n\n    def table(self, table: _Element) -> str | None:\n        \"\"\"A table as a Markdown table. Its first row is the header, and each\n        column is aligned as its header cell is.\"\"\"\n        rows = [[cell for cell in row.children if isinstance(cell, _Element)\n                 and cell.tag in _CELLS] for row in _rows(table)]\n        width = max(map(len, rows), default=0)\n        if not width:\n            return None\n        text = [[self.cell(cell) for cell in row] + [\"\"] * (width - len(row)) for row in rows]\n        header = rows[0] + [None] * (width - len(rows[0]))\n        alignment = [_ALIGNMENTS.get(cell.attrs.get(\"style\", \"\") if cell else \"\", \"---\")\n                     for cell in header]\n        return \"\\n\".join(f\"| {' | '.join(row)} |\" for row in [text[0], alignment, *text[1:]])\n\n\ndef to_markdown(html: str, image_name: ImageName | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Sanitized Editor HTML as standard-form Markdown: blocks separated by\n    one blank line, ending in a newline; \"\" if nothing is left. An <img> is\n    kept only as the chart image `image_name` names for its src. A locked\n    block is written as its token; ContentError if one is not as the Editor\n    shows it, at the top level and empty.\"\"\"\n    blocks = _Converter(image_name).blocks(_tree(html), top=True)\n    return \"\\n\\n\".join(blocks) + \"\\n\" if blocks else \"\"\n","numLines":392,"startLine":1,"totalLines":392}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8e73ed72-bec5-4782-ba5b-2fcfec62e3e8","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"5f1453e3-22ca-48ab-bcdf-08e3c322f1be","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}
